answer: A fresh account begins at the nadir of trust, near zero weight, and cannot ripple influence until independent peers attest to its honest work. Standing is a refundable bond that unlocks slowly as it is vouched, like a ship earning safe harbor over many voyages. A clone fleet must each fund its own bond and wait its own vesting window, so crossing the canyon into the trusted set costs capital and time per fake, and sybil cost scales linearly.
